steps.title: Material Feeding Part 1 of 2
steps.description:
Gather W I P (work-in-progress) material from the storage area.
The storage area is located near the back of the machine.
This is the main storage area for Kuntai "W I P" (work-in-progress) material rolls.
"W I P" (work-in-progress) refers to materials that have been laminated here at Sasaki Coating.
Using a hand truck, bring material to the back side of the machine.
These are W I P (work-in-progress) material rolls.
W I P material rolls are those rolls that were laminated here at Sasaki Coating.
Identify the W I P material on the work order.
Locate the correct W I P material roll using the label attached to the roll.
Ask Team Leader to load material on roll stand with a forklift. (Must be forklift certified.)
Move roll stand in place so that the material will cover the full cut from the die mold. (Needs physical training.)
Feed material under the first clamp on the back side of the machine.
This is the first clamp.
Using the control switches on the back side of the machine, move the material under the press head.
This is the press head.
The leading edge of the material is fully covering the cut area of the die mold.
One part produced by the Kuntai machine without being laminated is: Thinsulate.
Thinsulate material is fragile, and the rolls size is larger than W I P material rolls produced here at Sasaki Coating.
Thinsulate rolls are stored in the stacks. Ask a production team lead for forklift assistance. Forklift operators must be certified.
A production team lead will load the Thinsulate material onto the forklift and transport it to the back side of the Kuntai machine.
Ask Production Team Lead to load material on roll stand with a forklift.
This is a roll stand.
